texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information, visit abp.io.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MaxDurationMustBe: The longest booking allowed must be greater than zero minutes.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MaxHorizonDaysMus: How far ahead people can book must be greater than zero days.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinLeadMinutesMus: The minimum notice before a booking can't be negative.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:CapacityMustBePos: Capacity must be greater than zero.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:CapacityBelowMinA: Capacity can't drop below {1} while the minimum group size is {1} — lower the minimum first.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinAttendeesMustB: The minimum group size must be greater than zero.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinAttendeesExcee: The minimum group size ({0}) can't exceed this space's capacity ({1}).
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:DaysNotNarrower: These operating days aren't fully covered by the parent level's operating days.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:HoursNotNarrower: These operating hours aren't fully covered by the parent level's operating hours.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:OverrideEndsAtMus: A closure's end time must be after its start time.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:ReasonDetailTooLo: The closure's reason detail is too long.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:SpaceTypeNameAlre: A space type named '{0}' already exists.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:SpaceTypeInUse: This space type is still assigned to one or more spaces and can't be deleted.
texts.Dixels:Employees:UserIsNotAnEmployee: This user is not in the employee role, so a building can't be assigned to them.
